label: Claude Haiku 5.5
output:
Okay. Rohan, you asked straight, so here it is straight.

Last Friday I let go 6 of our 14 people. Yes, that was me, and yes, it was the worst day of my working life, worse than failing maths in 2nd sem, and that's saying something. Everyone got 2 months' pay. Four of them already have interviews lined up, and I'm still making calls for the others. I'm not saying that to get a pat on the back. I just want everyone to know nobody got dumped with nothing.

Why it happened: we were counting on a bridge round from a Hyderabad fund. The term sheet was basically ready, and then on 28 Oct it fell through. No drama, it just didn't happen. So we cut costs to buy time. Runway is about 5 months now.

Where the app stands: around 41k monthly users. The plumbers and electricians side is growing, and I'm genuinely happy about that. The AC servicing side is bleeding money, so we're shutting it down and focusing on housing societies. Three societies in HSR have already signed pilots. I think we have a real shot with that. I'm saying "real shot," not "sure thing," because it isn't a sure thing.

Now the part you actually care about. You and Divya put 3 lakh into the friends round in 2025, same terms as everyone else. You trusted me with real money, and you have every right to ask. Is it still a thing? Yes. Is it safe? I'm not going to promise that, because I don't know. It's at risk. It's not gone. Those are different things, and I'd rather you hear the difference from me than figure it out from a pitch deck later.

So here's what I'll do: I'll call you and Divya properly this week, both of you together if she's up for it, and walk through the actual numbers. Runway, the pilot pipeline, what happens in the good case and the bad case. If you think I'm wrong about something, good, tell me. You'll have the spreadsheet in front of you.

Don't start practising the sad face yet.

Also, for everyone else: yes, I've been eating Maggi at the office at 11pm so often that the security uncle now asks if I want masala or plain. I'm okay. Tired, a bit dramatic, but okay. Ajay, the cricket captain comparison is fair, I'll take it. I did mean the "grateful for every team member" line, which is probably why it sounds so stiff, so go ahead and laugh.

Sneha, you're right, let the man breathe. My amma also asked last week if TCS is still hiring, so if anyone has a good word to put in, I'm open to it.

Saturday, I'm coming. Pranav's buying. Dosa first, beer second, like he said. Let's keep runway talk off the table until dessert, and then we can argue about it.
